title: Chapter 1049
paragraphs: Chapter 1049
Episode 250. Zipple and Kinzelo (3)
- […Failed me, failed me of another world? What are you suddenly talking about, Helluram?]
- [You already feel it. It’s just as you sense.]
Looking at the black mass brought back vivid memories of the day Orgal visited Helluram. It was so overwhelming that he felt like vomiting.
Back then, Orgal couldn’t question Helluram further.
He had already deeply realized what she meant. Most members of the Abyss Legion shown by Helluram were, in fact, versions of Orgal himself.
- [How… How can there be so many of me? Where did all these numerous Orgal Remilias live? Are they split from me here? Or damn it, is there another world? A world with other Orgals?]
- [Numerous worlds exist. In all those worlds, you lived a similar life. You were my lover, the Demon King, the leader of Kinzelo, a pivotal key to the world.]
With each word Helluram uttered, Orgal felt his mind being contaminated. Even when he heard the world’s oldest secrets as her lover, he never felt such shock.
Orgal barely managed to breathe and looked up at Helluram. Drool was dripping from his mouth, and his body felt numb, almost paralyzed.
According to Helluram, there wasn't just one world.
There were many worlds where identical people lived, repeating similar histories.
- [I… I knew that the world could be altered. Like you or Solderet directly intervening, or the Zipple from a thousand years ago manipulating great history. And you told me that, Helluram.]
- [Yes. When I told you, I too thought that was all there was to it.]
- [But in reality, it’s not just an alteration, but that there are many identical worlds…?]
In the midst of wanting to faint, Orgal saw others. Fortunately, not all members of the Abyss Legion shown by Helluram were different versions of himself.
- [Then who are they…? They are not me, at least…!]
- [They are like you, ones who failed. Some failed to save themselves, others the world. But you were overwhelmingly numerous because you were chosen by me in all worlds.]
Failed to save the world.
Orgal focused on that phrase. His personal pursuit of salvation, the resurrection of the Sun God, was directly linked to the salvation of the world.
- [And I turned those numerous versions of you into soldiers, Orgal. I created the Abyss Legion.]
At that point, Orgal couldn't restrain himself and tried to stab Helluram with his sword, but his body wouldn't move as he intended.
Helluram hadn’t stopped him with her powers. His body simply wouldn’t respond due to exhaustion. But even if he had managed to strike her, she wouldn't have been hurt.
Orgal cursed and ranted for a while. But no vile words in the world could express his feelings.

- [You damned, cursed… witch, you crazy woman! Is this the consequence of other world Orgals not satisfying your desires? Failing to achieve Kinzelo’s grand ambition and even in death, becoming your plaything?]
- [It was not my desire that made so many of you like this, but your own. You always said you wouldn’t give up. I just fulfilled that fervent wish.]
- [Those versions of me wouldn’t have agreed to become such puppets!]
- [If that were the case, I wouldn’t have been able to create the Abyss Legion. You know it better than anyone, you said you’d never give up no matter what.]
That was indeed true.
Just as he felt when he first saw that most of the Abyss Legion were ‘him’, Orgal knew the choices they must have made in the end. Because they were his choices.
He might not have agreed to become a puppet, but his fierce denial was just a struggle against reality.
- [Others too, all of them came to me after failing.]
- [Ha, hahaha! Hahaha! Hahaha!]
Laughter erupted. Orgal realized quite clearly and quickly that he was going mad, but he couldn’t bear it without losing his mind.

- [Okay! Alright, let's get this straight, Helluram. So, I was your lover, your contractor. In countless identical worlds, Orgal Remilias was always your contractor. But always failed, what? From my perspective, the resurrection of Kinzelo, and from yours, what? You wanted the light to disappear from the world, right? That’s why we separated.]
- [Yes, that story is still valid.]
- [But can you say that all these countless Orgals and some unknown fools are not your playthings?]
- [If the world disappears before I erase the light…]
- [Huh?]
- [Or if I cease to exist by something, becoming as if I never existed…]
- [What are you talking about… Who can erase you? Solderet? The resurrected Sun God?]
- [Solderet has lost almost all his power, and the Sun God has not been resurrected in any world. Without Solderet’s power, he cannot return. I told you many times, but you didn’t believe.]
- [Then who… Who can, are you saying…]
Zipple.
Suddenly, the Zipple family came to Orgal’s mind. Even though it seemed impossible for mere magicians to accomplish what even Solderet or the Sun God Kinzelo couldn’t.
- [No, even if they complete the Origin Stone and gain immense power… they can’t erase you, can they? People might forget you forever, but they can't eliminate you, right?]
- [Look into the eyes of the soldiers, Orgal.]
Hesitantly, Orgal locked eyes with a soldier. Then, after a moment, the final moments of that soldier’s life started flowing into his mind.
- [Malugia! Will you remain bound to Zipple until the end, wake up! Destroy this world instead! Every world is becoming subservient to Zipple!]
- [Chiron! Come to your senses, you have to cut the Holy Crown! If you can’t cut it, Chiron!]
- [No, stop, Veradin!]
It was something he had experienced. Events from another world’s version of himself were vividly disrupting his mind as if they had happened yesterday.

In a world where the Origin Stone was completed, it was the moment of the final battle with Zipple. Chiron had returned to the mortal world without completing his task, and Veradin was participating in the battle as a Genesis magician.
And they were losing. The pen of historical manipulation was erasing their comrades right before their eyes in real-time, and it seemed even Helluram couldn’t resist that power.

Memories in his mind were incessantly renewed. The recently vanished Chiron appeared and then disappeared in his memories, and new memories formed where Veradin had never left Zipple and was always an enemy.
Of course, the Orgal of that world couldn’t distinguish those memories. What he had experienced and what was manipulated.
There was no need to distinguish. From the moment history was manipulated, all of it became the truth.
- [Oh, this madness… Mad, mad, damn it!]
Orgal collapsed and furiously punched the ground. Then, he barely lifted his head to look into the eyes of other soldiers, and it was a similar pattern.
Zipple was dominating the world, and he was losing to them.
Sometimes he fought the last battle with Temar in the Thousand-Year Sword Demon War, and sometimes the avatars of the Sun God who wanted to maintain the world lent their strength.
But the outcome never changed. The numerous Orgals never won, not even once.

- [In all these worlds, never won? Not even once? Please say it’s not true, please! Right! There was another enemy, wasn’t there, aaah! World destruction? This is my best effort? Even knowing the world is not one, knowing all this, I still kept losing!?]
- [If only you and I knew the truth, maybe we could have won. But who do you think was the first to realize that this world is not one, but many?]
Zipple.
It was Zipple. The world split into many the moment they began manipulating history.
- [The battle in this world is over, Orgal Remilias. You and your comrades will be forgotten again. The witch too… will be diminished.]
It was Kelliark’s voice.
It was a relief that he had no strength left in his body. If he had the strength to clench his fists, Orgal would have torn his ears off right now.
- [Do you understand now? How the Abyss Legion was created.]
It was Orgal himself who had suggested the name ‘Abyss Legion’ to Helluram.
He said that even if he failed, he would keep fighting to the end, and if these versions of himself continued to gather, they might eventually form a legion and win at least once.
Orgal was crying so much that he couldn’t see. The layered despair and loss from the other worlds, the stark reality that certainly existed, crushed him.
- [The Origin Stone in this world is not yet complete. But Zipple has already devoured many worlds.]
From ‘the complete Sun God Kinzelo’ to the tiniest invisible creature.
In the end, none could exist without a world. Even the Sun God Kinzelo, from the moment of creation, became bound to the world.
Everything was proceeding according to Zipple’s will. That’s why the Sun God never resurrected. In the endings Orgal saw, Zipple fiercely checked the resurrection of the Sun God and always succeeded.
- [Orgal. Really, how many worlds do you think are left?]
- […How many are left?]
- [I’m asking because I don’t know.]
- [How would I know if you don’t know!]

- [It’s not important. Whether many are left or, in fact, this place is the last world. If we can’t stop Zipple, everyone in this world will face the end. So, this is definitely the last world. The last world where even a faint possibility has not completely closed.]
